when the buyer would actually pay it and pickup can be run as the what-if\u0022,\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:[\u0022The carvana detail walk scrolls far enough to render the \\u0027Pickup and Delivery\\u0027 block and reads it deterministically: the pickup line and its location (\\u0027Pick it up from our Orlando location\\u0027 then \\u0027Orlando, FL\\u0027) into PostingEntity.PickupLocation with PickupFee 0 when no fee is printed under the pickup option, and the fee printed under the delivery option into ShippingFee as today; a page whose block did not render leaves both pickup fields null and keeps the header shipping fee; proven by tests over a fixture cut from the live block recorded on 2026-09-26 for vehicle/4746813 and by the existing shipping-fee tests\u0022,\u0022The scenario gains an optional fulfillment field with the values delivery (default) and pickup, read by ScenarioLoader; VehiclePricing\\u0027s purchase price adds the shipping fee under delivery and the pickup fee (zero when known, null treated as the shipping fee) under pickup; odo show prints both figures and which one the analysis assumed, and rank --detail names the one it used; odo budget and rank accept --fulfillment pickup to override the scenario for one run; proven by tests for both settings\u0022,\u0022docs/cost-model.md and docs/scenario.md describe the field and the default, and docs/walk.md describes the block; the README\\u0027s quick start is unchanged; dotnet build and dotnet test succeed with zero warnings; commits are small with conventional messages, no em dashes, no AI attribution\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Feature\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022From the discovery walk of idea adf5634b, stop 2, and this window\\u0027s probe (ideas/adf5634b-site-specific-logic-for-each-walk-site-use-each-site-s-own-f/workspace/journal.md, Probes). Brian\\u0027s ruling in his words: \\u0027I don\\u0027t want that to be the locked-in standard for the whole application ... maybe there\\u0027s a pickup in North Carolina that we want to go to ... Maybe we just account for both, either a delivery or a pickup ... and then let that be sort of the what-if scenario.\\u0027 Verified 2026-09-26 about 12:55 EDT over CDP on https://www.carvana.com/vehicle/4746813 (a 990-dollar shipping car): the block reads, line by line, \\u0027Pickup and Delivery\\u0027, \\u0027Pickup Wednesday\\u0027, \\u0027Pick it up from our Orlando location\\u0027, \\u0027Orlando, FL\\u0027, \\u0027or\\u0027, \\u0027Delivery Tuesday\\u0027, \\u0027Delivered to you within 3 days\\u0027, \\u0027Orlando, FL\\u0027, then the shipping amount; the fee sits under the delivery option only and the pickup option prints no fee. The block renders only after scrolling about a third of the page; a second car (vehicle/4726115) did not render it within ten seconds, so the reader must tolerate absence.
